entities.summary: Keith Joseph Loneker was an American professional football guard and actor. For much of his acting career, his large football-lineman build garnered him roles largely as thugs or football players. His first movie was director Steven Soderbergh's Out of Sight (1998) and later the Neil LaBute thriller, Lakeview Terrace (2008).
